7.6.1 Operation Cycle Counters
[SWS_Dem_01358] Initialization of Operation Cycle Counters ⌈If a new event
memory entry is created for an event then the operation cycle counters ’Cycles since
last failed’, ’Cycles since first failed’ and ’Failed cycles’ shall be initialized to zero.⌋
[SWS_Dem_01359]
Size of Operation Cycle Counters ⌈Each operation cycle
counter defined in [SWS_Dem_01358] shall have the size of one byte.⌋
[SWS_Dem_01360] Overflow handling of Operation Cycle Counters ⌈If any count
operation for an operation cycle counter occurs which would cause it to roll over past
0xFF then it shall instead be maintained at 0xFF.⌋
